summary: 2026 Ducati Lenovo Team (Marc Marquez, Francesco Bagnaia). Lenovo is the title partner (front). Ducati's own partner page, as archived on 23 May and 18 Sep 2026, lists 47 more partners, all recorded here: Monster Energy, Shell, Audi and TIM as Main Partners; Akrapovič, NetApp, Riello UPS and Unipol as Official Sponsors; Aruba, Autogrill, Bosch, Carlo Barbera, Carrera, Contadi Castaldi, Diadora, Eataly, Estrella Galicia, Eternoo, Flex-Box, Frecciarossa, Givi, Isokinetic, ITA Airways, Limolane, Madonna di Campiglio, Motorola, New Era, Parmacotto, Philip Morris International, Randstad, SAP and Silence as Official Partners; and Beta, DID, Domino, Mahle, Marelli, NGK, Reflexallen, Siemens, SKF, Streparava, Tecnoelettra, Thermal Technology, Var Group, WD-40 and WRS as technical partners. The page shows most partners as a logo with a link, not by name in its text. Elica, Daiko, Melinda, Amaro Montenegro, Vmoto, Brembo and Cobo, on Ducati's US partner page in December 2025, are not on the 2026 list.
